mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 0.3% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) when inflation crosses above 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly PAYEMS labor cost index predicts stronger wage growth, which raises expected corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 200-day window, 60-day forward returns are negative despite sustained upward PAYEMS momentum (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in monthly GDPC1 personal consumption expenditure coincides with a sharp drop in RSAFS retail sales, signaling softening demand that produces negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 < previous month and RSAFS < previous month
failure_condition: Over 100-day window, 5-day forward returns are not consistently negative when both GDPC1 and RSAFS decline (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in monthly INDPRO manufacturing index below 90 suggests supply-side pressures, which typically precede negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Over 12 months, INDPRO contraction is not associated with negative 20-day forward returns (correlation < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 4%, the increased discount rate erodes equity present value, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns regardless of other signals.
failure_condition: Over 1000 days, 5-day forward returns remain positive whenever FEDFUNDS > 4% (p < 0.01).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in UNRATE unemployment rate below 4.5% triggers a risk-off reaction as investors anticipate job market weakness, yielding negative S&P 500 20-day returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses below 4.5% in the current month
failure_condition: Over 6 months, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.5% (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in HOUST housing starts and GDPC1 personal consumption indicate dual demand weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 60-day returns in this regime.
failure_condition: Over 3 years, 60-day forward returns are not negative when both HOUST and GDPC1 are declining (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in FEDFUNDS for three consecutive months is interpreted as persistent monetary easing, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 20-day returns.
failure_condition: Over 24 months, 20-day forward returns are not higher than average during such streaks (p > 0.05).
